Transit Time Finder . The Transit Time Finder provides you with the delivery date for a selected service. . You are required to select the Blue Dart service required by you, the Origin and Destination City and the pick up date and time below. . To confirm if the service required by you is available, for the origin and destination selected, please check with our Location Finder . For detailed information on our services, refer to our Service Guide . . NOTE 1 : The scheduled delivery date given is subject to the Terms And Conditions Of Carriage, details of which are available in our Service Guide . . NOTE 2 : Some locations in or around the city could be out of delivery area and may require extra time for delivery - Contact Customer Service . . NOTE 3 : Transit Time arrived at are on best estimate basis and it is advisable to Contact Customer Service for your definite shipping needs. . NOTE 4 : Non documents shipments are subject to stricter customs, excise, and/or regulatory checks which may cause delays - please refer further to disclaimer section. . . Price Finder . The Price Finder helps you to calculate your shipping charges for your service type needs. . Charges will be based on the weight of the shipment in kgs or fractions thereof and may be assessible either on the gross weight of the shipment or the volume/dimensional weight of the shipment - whichever is higher. . The chargeable weight may be expressed as fractions of a kg. such as 0.25 kgs or 0.5 kgs and may go upto 9999 kgs. . If you wish to contact our centralized customer service click here . .
